as_told.title: The Typhoon submarine appears as McMoneagle described it

plain: In 1979, the story goes, a remote viewer named Joe McMoneagle used remote viewing, the claimed ability to describe faraway places with the mind alone, to describe a huge submarine being built at a Russian shipyard on the White Sea. Eight months after those sessions ended, the Russians floated out the Typhoon, "the biggest submarine ever built," with its missile tubes placed the way the sessions had it. Paul Smith tells this on two episodes as something McMoneagle told him, and if it is true the mind could see secret military work no camera could reach.
